# SideQuest

> SideQuest matches you with locals for short, spontaneous adventures — coffee crawls, sunset hikes, trivia nights, and other tiny quests under three hours.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SideQuest and tonight's featured quests.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): How matching, quests, and meetups work.
- [Browse quests](/quests): Joinable sidequests near you.
- [Map](/map): Live worldwide map of members and quests.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Points, streaks, and crew competitions.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free Basic plan and $8.99/mo Premium.
- [About](/about): The team and story behind SideQuest.
- [Sign in / sign up](/auth): Create an account or log in.
